Updates the relationships in the squads: ten random pairs of team-mates: a disliked one stops being disliked and may fight (`exe::news_post_feud_settled`); otherwise becomes disliked, liked or stops being liked; every 50 days, random clubs go through the dressing room friction; on the other days each player, by attribute draws, may reach friction with the manager. \n `game_update_squad_relationships()`, every day from the game's day loop. (1) Ten times: a random club and two random squad slots (`club::SQUAD`, 50); different people and random(the first one's `.professionalism()`) = 0: if the first dislikes the second, he stops disliking him (`exe::staff_remove_disliked_staff`) and, at the same contract club and with the link flagged in `.grievances()` & 0x800, the fight (`exe::news_post_feud_settled`); otherwise, 1/3 start disliking (`exe::staff_add_disliked_staff`), 1/3 of the rest start liking (`exe::staff_add_favoured_staff`) and the rest stop liking (`exe::staff_remove_favoured_staff`). Sets the match player's facing direction in degrees (`match_player::FACING`, 0..=359) from cell (a, b) towards (c, d) (same cell: random, except two fixed goal cases 0 and 180), plus a random deviation of up to +-30 when `.moment_agility()` x `.moment_anticipation()` < random(120), plus twice the difference of two player-data attributes (`.right_foot()` - `.left_foot()`).

Marks read the first unread news item with the id in the human's ring, unless it needs a reply, takes it off the count and, when asked, repeats it for the humans on the same network machine. \n `News::mark_item_read(manager, id, sincronizar)`: in the human's ring of 100 slots (`news_fields::HUMAN_INBOXES`, by id − `G_STAFF_COUNT` + 16), the first slot with the `id` (`news_item::ID`) not yet read (`news_item::READ` = 0) whose button (`exe::newsitem_get_action_button` on 0xde1f64) does not ask for a reply (2) becomes read and leaves the count (+8 of the entry). No ring: 0. Otherwise (even when not found), with `sincronizar`, it repeats (without sync, `exe::news_mark_item_read`) for the other humans (`.classification()` = 1) on the same network machine (`exe::screenmanager_find_manager_channel`) as the current human; returns 1. No manager, no id, or a manager of the machine: the "Error" box and 0.

marks the scope as club (`news_item::REACH` = 0) and delivers the item (`exe::news_deliver_to_manager`) to the club manager (`.manager()`) when he is human (among the last 16 people, `G_STAFF_COUNT`); turned off (DESLIGADAS) from 2026-10-29 to 2026-10-31, when the test criterion changed and the list was emptied (the detour, even passing through, changes the stack residue a later original reads: the career left be54a138); the copy stays in the code and does not run

Applies the automatic reply for the club to the human's inbox, from the newest item to the oldest, up to the empty slot. \n `News::auto_respond_all(manager, club)`: from the newest to the oldest news item of the human's ring, up to the first empty slot (`news_item::ID` = 0), gives the automatic reply (`exe::newsitem_auto_respond`) for the `club`. No manager or a manager of the machine: the "Error" box and 0; no ring or at the end: 1. TapeCall when going on holiday, when sacked and when hired.

Without "urgent only", tells whether there is an unread item; with it, whether an item needs a reply or is important and unread. \n `News::has_urgent_items(manager, so_urgentes)`: without `so_urgentes`, whether there is an unread news item (`exe::news_count_unread` > 0). With it, from the newest to the oldest of the human's ring, up to the first empty slot (`news_item::ID` = 0): 1 if one needs a reply (the text `exe::newsitem_get_action_button` on 0xde1f64 returns 2) or is important (`news_item::IMPORTANT` = 1) and unread (`news_item::READ` = 0). A manager of the machine: the "Error" box and 0.

Copies the text into the news item's slots from the given slot and returns the first free slot after it (at most 50). \n `NewsItem::set_slot_string(field, text, next)`: copies the `text` into the news item's slots from slot `field` (strncpy `exe::at_9466d0` at `news_item::DATA` + 4·field, up to 200 − 4·field bytes), terminates the area (`news_item::TEXT_END` = 0) and, with `next`, writes the first free slot after the text (the length with the terminating zero rounded up to 4, in slots, plus `field`; at most 50). Slot outside 0..49 or no text: the "Error" box and 0; otherwise 1.

Sets the continent scope (`news_item::REACH` = 3) and delivers the news to every active human manager whose club or nation is in the continent. \n `News::send_to_continent_managers(news, continent)`: continent scope (`news_item::REACH` = 3) and delivery (`exe::news_deliver_to_manager` with 0) to each active human manager whose club (`staff::CLUB_JOB`) has its nation (`.nation()`) in the `continent` (`.continent()`) or whose nation (`staff::NATION`) is in it. Returns 1, or 0 on the first refusal. Null news or continent: as in the original ("Error" box).

Delivers the news to the managers of the competition's nation (`send_to_nation_club_managers`), else of its continent (`send_to_continent_managers`), else to all (`send_to_all_managers`). \n `News::send_to_comp_region(news, comp)`: with the competition's nation (`.nation()`), to the nation's managers (`FN_NEWS_SEND_TO_NATION_CLUB_MANAGERS`); otherwise, with the continent (`.continent()`), to the continent's (`FN_NEWS_SEND_TO_CONTINENT_MANAGERS`); otherwise to all (`FN_NEWS_SEND_TO_ALL_MANAGERS`). Returns what the delivery returns. Null news or competition: as in the original ("Error" box).

Tells whether the news item is important for the person, by category and type (bids on the person's club, the humans...). \n `person.is_important_for()`: is the news important for the person (the byte +4 that the delivery `deliver_to_manager` writes)? By the category (`exe::newsitem_get_category`) and the type (+0): category 2, types 7 to 0xb, 0x27 and 0x28; category 4, 0xbb8, 0xbb9 and 0xbc4; category 5, a fixed list, 0xfa1 if the person is the manager of the club in data 5 (+0x19) and 0xfb6 if he is that of data 4 (+0x15) or of data 5; category 6, 0x1770 if data 0 (`news_item::DATA`) is one of the 16 human managers (`G_STAFF_COUNT`); category 1, 0x1388; the rest, 0. The original calls `exe::newsitem_get_category` up to six times (it only reads): the port calls it once. Null person or type outside 1..0x1790 (`exe::newsitem_get_category`'s box): as in the original.
all scope (`news_item::REACH` = 4) and delivery (`exe::news_deliver_to_manager`) to every active human manager; 1, or 0 on the first refusal

Sets the division scope (`news_item::REACH` = 1) and delivers the news to every active human manager with a club in the division (`.division()`); returns 1, or 0 on the first refusal. \n `News::send_to_division_managers(news, division)`: division scope (`news_item::REACH` = 1) and delivery to each active human manager with a club (`staff::CLUB_JOB`) in the `division` (`.division()`). Returns 1, or 0 on the first refusal. Null news or division: as in the original ("Error" box).

Sets the nation scope (`news_item::REACH` = 2) and delivers the news to every active human manager whose club or national team belongs to the nation (`club::NATION`); returns 0. \n `News::send_to_nation_managers(news, nation)`: nation scope (`news_item::REACH` = 2) and delivery to each active human manager whose club (`staff::CLUB_JOB`) or national team (`staff::NATIONAL_JOB`) belongs to the `nation` (`club::NATION`). Returns 0. Null news or nation: as in the original ("Error" box).

Sets the nation scope (`news_item::REACH` = 2) and delivers the news (`exe::news_deliver_to_manager`) to every active human manager with a club of the nation; the first refusal stops. \n `News::send_to_nation_club_managers(news, nation)`: the news gets the nation scope (`news_item::REACH` = 2) and goes (`exe::news_deliver_to_manager` with 0) to each of the 16 human managers (the last 16 of `G_STAFF_TABLE`, `staff::SIZE` bytes) who are active (`.classification()` = 1) with a club (`.club_job()`) of the `nation` (`.nation()`); the first refused delivery (0) stops it. Returns 0. Null news or nation: as in the original ("Error" box).

Counts the unread news in a human manager's inbox, in total or for one category. \n Without a category (0): the entry's total (+8, negative becomes 0). With a category: of the 100 news items in the inbox (start at entry +0; −1 = empty, 0), the occupied ones (`news_item::ID`) of the category (`exe::newsitem_get_category`) not yet read (`news_item::READ` = 0). Null manager or out of range: as in the original (error box).

Gives the default replies for the manager's club and national team (`exe::news_auto_respond_all`) and empties his inbox (the 100 news items with `news_item::ID` = 0 and `news_item::READ` = 1). \n `News::clear_inbox(manager)`, from 0x6b28b0 and from loading the game (`load_game_data`): the default replies to the news of the manager's club (+0x39) and national team (+0x24) (`exe::news_auto_respond_all`); then the human's inbox (12-byte record at [`news_fields::HUMAN_INBOXES`], by id − `G_STAFF_COUNT` + 16): +4 = +0 and +8 = 0; with the first news item (+0, −1 none), the 100 news items of 0xdf bytes from it ([this]) with `news_item::ID` = 0 and `news_item::READ` = 1. No manager or a negative index: the error box (lines 0x24c1 and 0x24cc).

builds the news item: type (+0), important byte (`news_item::IMPORTANT`), the 50 data slots (`news_item::DATA`) cleared, today's date (`news_item::DATE`), byte `G_CURRENT_DAY_SLICE` at `news_item::DAY_SLICE`, id (`news_item::ID`) and `news_item::READ` cleared; turned off (DESLIGADAS) from 2026-10-29 to 2026-10-31, when the test criterion changed and the list was emptied: with the detour the career in Rust mode left the reference be54a138 (bisection of batch 251's 39 routines; with `construct_news_item`, the news constructor, the game later crashed in `player_stats_reset_player` on a broken index); the cause (stack residue or a difference in the copy) is not isolated yet; the copy stays in the code and does not run

Returns a new array with the human's inbox items, newest first, only those of one category when asked, and the count. \n `News::get_inbox_items(manager, count, category)`: a new vector of 100 news items (malloc `exe::crt_malloc` of 0x571c, on the first one found; `*count` = 0) with the news of the human's ring (`news_fields::HUMAN_INBOXES`), from the newest to the oldest up to the empty slot (`news_item::ID` = 0), only those of the `category` (`exe::newsitem_get_category`) if it is not 0, copied (`exe::newsitem_operator_3d`); `*count` adds one per news item. Returns the vector (0 if none; `*count` untouched). No manager or a manager of the machine: the "Error" box and 0.

Copies a news item (0xdf bytes): +0, +4, the 50 tokens (+5), the date (`news_item::DATE`), `news_item::DAY_SLICE`, `news_item::ID`, `news_item::READ` and `news_item::REACH`. \n `NewsItem::operator=`: copies the news item (0xdf bytes) from `source`: +0 (dword), +4 (byte), the 50 tokens from +5 (dwords, in order), the date at `news_item::DATE`, `news_item::DAY_SLICE` (byte), `news_item::ID` and `news_item::READ` (dwords) and `news_item::REACH` (byte). Returns `this`.

Returns statistic `which` 1..22 of the record (bytes, percentages ×100.0f, per-match averages, the two ratings completed with under 20 matches ×0.05f), in x87 like the original. \n Statistic `which` of record `r` (matches at +0, bytes +2..+0xd, words +0xe..+0x1a, +0x1c integer), as the original leaves it in x87: 1..12 the bytes; 13 and 16 the percentages (+0x12/+0x10 and +0x1a/+0x18, times 100.0f); 14, 15, 17 and 21 the per-match averages; 18 the average of +0xe with fewer than 20 matches completed by `weight` (times 0.05f); 20 the rating (2×+9 − +0xa + matches, completed by 1.5 with fewer than 20 matches; 1.5f with no matches); 22 the integer. No divisor: 0.0. Null `r`, 19 or outside 1..22: the original (error box).

Returns the average of the record's five 4-bit ratings (zero counts as 27), 16-bit, divided by 4. \n The average of the five 4-bit ratings of record `*index` (0x27 bytes each, starting at `[this + player_stats_fields::PLAYER_ENTRIES]`): the two halves of `player_stats_entry::RECENT_RATINGS` and of `player_stats_entry::RECENT_RATINGS` + 1 and the low half of `player_stats_entry::LAST_RATING`, each ×4 (zero counts as 27), summed in 16 bits and divided by 4 (truncating). Null `index`: the original (error box).

When the player leaves a club: the season's stats of each category go to the history file (with the year, the club, the fee and the kind of exit) and are cleared; an empty node when the last category is missing; and the games and goals for the club are recounted from the history. \n `PlayerStats::archive_player_stats(p, value, loan, end, club_id, other)`, called from club exits (contracts 0x4c7ac0/`toggle_squad_placement`/`sign_loan_contract`/`end_loan`, `manager_manager_remove_player_from_squad` the squad, `end_season_for_key_nation` the national teams). The node type: 2 with `loan`, 1 with `end`, 3 with `other`, otherwise 0. Null person: the error box (line 0xf28) and 0; without a record: 0. Each of the six categories with a record (the record's 39-byte entry in `player_stats_fields::PLAYER_ENTRIES`) goes to the history (the current year and club, `.club_job()`, the record's 32 bytes in `player_stats_fields::CATEGORY_RECORDS`, `value`, the category and the type) and the record is cleared. Without the sixth category, an empty category 6 node with `value` when: `value` ≥ 0 or `end`; or `club_id` ≥ 0 and: outside the season of the club's nation (table `G_LEAGUE_WORLD_CUP_START_DATE`); or, without the nation or in its season, less than 365 days since joining the club (`.date_joined_club()`/`.date_joined_club_leap_year()`, `exe::date_days_since`). With `club_id` ≥ 0 or `value` ≥ 0: the games (`player_stats_entry::CLUB_LEAGUE_GAMES`) and goals (`player_stats_entry::CLUB_LEAGUE_GOALS`) for `club_id` are recounted from the category 2 nodes of the history (`exe::file_llist_get_nodes`). Returns 1.

Builds the player's career table, six entries (categories) per season and club: the current season, then those from the history file from newest to oldest with the empty years filled, the repeated entries of the same season and club summed and the empty groups removed. \n `PlayerStats::build_career_history(p, &count)`: the table (malloc `exe::crt_malloc` of 500 entries, realloc `exe::crt_realloc` in steps of 500; the caller frees it with `exe::crt_free`) with six entries per season and club, and the count in `*count`. Null person (line 0xb98) or without a record (0xbaa): the error box and 0; id from `G_STAFF_COUNT` on: 0; out of memory: the error box (0xbb2, 0xc00, 0xc26, 0xc41) and 0. \n (1) The current season: the six categories with the year of the club's season (`exe::key_nation_get_club_season_year`), the club (`.club_job()`; −1 without one), transfer −1 and the category's 32 bytes (`exe::playerstats_get_category_record`) when present. (2) The history from the file (FILE_LLIST::get_nodes `exe::file_llist_get_nodes` of `[this]` by the positions `player_stats_entry::HISTORY_START`/`player_stats_entry::HISTORY_LAST` of the record's 0x27-byte entry in `player_stats_fields::PLAYER_ENTRIES`), from end to start (`exe::llist_get_prev`): each node of another season, club or type opens a group: the count moves on by 6; empty years between the two (until the count exceeds 500) become empty groups (club −1, transfer −1); the node's group takes the year, the club, the transfer and the node's type; the node goes into the entry for its category (`career_entry::KIND` / 8) in the group. The list is destroyed (`exe::drop_llist` and `exe::crt_operator_delete`). (3) The count moves on by 6; each entry takes the transfer and the type of the entry six ahead (those of the last group, −1 and 0). (4) A group followed by one of the same year and club, with no transfer in either, the following one's type other than 1 and the word `career_entry::STATS_RATING_TOTAL` other than −1 in both, adds bytes `career_entry::STATS`..+0x13 and the word `career_entry::STATS_RATING_TOTAL` into the following one and disappears (year 0). (5) A group without matches (`career_entry::STATS`, `career_entry::STATS_SUB_APPEARANCES` of the first and the last entry), with a year, without a transfer and of type 0 disappears when it has no club or when another group has its year and the next group is of the same club; one with matches whose last entry has no club (+0xd9) also disappears. (6) The year-0 groups leave the table (the following ones move down) and the count drops by 6 per group.

Returns how many years since the person played for the club: 0 when they are there, −1 when never. \n `player_stats_years_since_at_club(p, club)`: how many years since the person played for the club: 0 if they are in it (`.club_job()`), −1 if never; otherwise today's year (`G_CURRENT_DATE_YEAR`) minus the highest year among the history groups (`exe::playerstats_build_career_history` on `G_PLAYER_STATS`; the last entry of each group, +0xd7 the year, +0xd9 the club) with the club. Null person (line 0x133f), null club (0x1347) or without a record (0x135f): the error box and −1; id from `G_STAFF_COUNT` on: −1. The caller calls it with the PlayerStats in ecx, which it does not use. Called from 0x5b03e0 (does not run in the automatic career: it passes through untested).

Returns the requested statistic of the category record (without a record, the default for the rating and the average), or the combined ratings of categories 2 to 5. \n `PlayerStats::get_stat(player, category, which, default)`, as the original leaves it in x87. No player: the "Error" box (line 0x659) and 0.0; id (+0) outside the table (`G_PLAYER_DATA_COUNT`): 0.0. With `which` ≠ 0x13 and the category (signed byte) up to 6: the category record (`exe::playerstats_get_category_record`) gives the statistic (`FN_PLAYER_STATS_GET_RECORD_VALUE` with `which` and `default`); without a record, `default` for 0x12 and 0x14 and 0.0 for the others. Otherwise the combined ratings from categories 2+3 (matches n and total t of `player_category_stats::RATING_TOTAL`: n < 20, ((20 − n)·5 + t)·0.05f; otherwise t/n; stored as f32), 4 (n < 8, ((8 − n)·3 + t)·0.125; otherwise t/n; f32) and 5 (n < 5, ((5 − n) + t)·0.2f; otherwise t/n; in x87): category 100, (c5·1.5 + c4·2.5 + c23·6)·0.1; 101, (c5·3 + c4·5 + 2·c23)·0.1; 102, (c5·5 + c4·4 + c23)·0.1; the others 0.0. Without record 4 or 5 the original reads uninitialised locals (the copy uses zero; the comparer leaves those cases to the original). Called from the line-up choice `lineup_slot_score`, MATCH_PLAYER::setup `exe::match_player_setup`, the club reputation `club_reputation_for_staff`, the player strength `staff_get_player_strength_flags`, the staff's daily pass 0x5ce2d0 and others. Hot: no counter.

The order of the language records: by person id and by language, with 0xff matching any language. \n `player_stats_compare_language_entries(a, b)` (the qsort and bsearch of the languages, 6-byte records {id, language, fluency}): null a, −1; null b, 1; different ids (+0), the difference; language 0xff in either one, 0; otherwise the difference of the languages (`language_entry::LANGUAGE`, signed). Used by the language fluency `get_language_fluency` and by the languages added, removed and improved.

Sums the goals of every season and club of the player's career table (`build_career_history`), in 16 bits. \n The original receives the PlayerStats in ecx and does not read it. `player_stats_get_career_goals(person)` (called from MATCH_PLAYER::setup `exe::match_player_setup`, which writes it into +0x43 of the match player): null person, the "Error" box (line 0xb4b) and 0; id from `G_STAFF_COUNT` on, 0; without the player record (`.player()`), the error box (line 0xb5d) and 0. Otherwise the career table (`exe::playerstats_build_career_history` of `G_PLAYER_STATS`: 0x2b-byte entries, six per season and club) and the sum, in 16 bits, of byte +8 of the sixth entry of each group (+0xdf); the table is freed (`exe::crt_free`, also when null). Hot (every player of every match): no counter.

Returns the 0x20-byte record of the player's category (1..6), through the index in the 39-byte entry of his id; 0 without an index. \n `PlayerStats::get_category_record(player, category)`: the 0x20-byte record (`[this + player_stats_fields::CATEGORY_RECORDS]` + 32 × index) of the player's category (category_slot), or 0 when the index is −1 or lower. No player or outside 1..6: the "Error" box and 0: the original. Called from PlayerStats::record_match 0x7c10e6 and PlayerStats::get_stat `get_stat` (the match engine's averages). Hot: no counter.

Returns the player's category record; without an index, the first free record (`player_category_stats::RATING_TOTAL` = 0xffff) or a new one at the end (grows by 100), zeroed. \n `PlayerStats::create_stats(player, category)`: the player's category record (category_slot); without an index (−1), with loose records (`player_stats_fields::FREE_CATEGORY_COUNT`), the first record of `player_stats_fields::CATEGORY_RECORDS` (count `player_stats_fields::CATEGORY_COUNT`) with `player_category_stats::RATING_TOTAL` = 0xffff becomes his (cleared; the loose count goes down); otherwise one at the end (cleared; the count goes up): when full (capacity `player_stats_fields::CATEGORY_CAPACITY`), it grows in steps of 100 (realloc `exe::crt_realloc`; out of memory, the error box 0xef4 and 0). No player or outside 1..6: the "Error" box and 0: the original. Called from PlayerStats::record_match 0x7c10f9.

Appends the new entry to the language table (6 bytes: id, language, fluency up to 10; starts at 100, grows by 100) and sorts it when asked (qsort). \n `PlayerStats::add_language(person, language, fluencia, sort)`: the language table (6 bytes per record in `player_stats_fields::LANGUAGES`, capacity `player_stats_fields::LANGUAGE_CAPACITY`, count `player_stats_fields::LANGUAGE_COUNT`) starts with 100 (malloc `exe::crt_malloc` 0x258) and grows by 100 (realloc `exe::crt_realloc`) when full; the new record at the end: the person's id, the language (`language_entry::LANGUAGE`) and the fluency (`language_entry::FLUENCY`, at most 10, signed); with `sort`, qsort (`exe::crt_qsort`) with the comparison `player_stats_compare_language_entries`. Out of memory: fatal error box.

Returns from 0 to 10 how well the person speaks the language: the contract level, 10 for a nation (or the second one) speaking the language, or the learned language (binary search). \n `PlayerStats::get_language_fluency(person, club, language, by_contract)`: how well the person speaks `language` (0 to 10). Human manager (id ≥ `G_STAFF_COUNT`): 10 if it is the language (`.first_language()`) of their nation (`.nation()`), otherwise 0. With `by_contract`, the contract with the club (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`) of someone playing at a club (`.club_job()`) of the same nation as `club` (`.nation()`): the contract level (`.squad_status()` & 0xf). 10 if the nation (`.nation()`) or the second one (`.second_nation()`) speaks the language of `club`'s nation or `language`. Otherwise the learned language: the binary search (bsearch `exe::crt_bsearch`, comparison `player_stats_compare_language_entries`, 6-byte records at `player_stats_fields::LANGUAGES`, `player_stats_fields::LANGUAGE_COUNT` of them) for the key {id, language}, byte `language_entry::FLUENCY`; without the table or the record, 0. The callers read only `al`.

Records a match in the statistics: by each side's category (friendly, reserves, competition type; a random draw in a simulated match), adds the rating and the match to the double sums and each player who played to the category records (games, goals, score, rating, minutes...), to the player's games and goals and to contract `contract::CLUB_APPEARANCES`; shifts the form by half a byte. \n `PlayerStats::record_match(p, game)` (the fixture and the match): null `p` or `game`, the error boxes and 0. Competition −2 (simulated match): the category is random(9) ≠ 0 ? 2 : 3 for both sides; otherwise each side's own (match_stats_category). In each row that counts (match_lineup_row): the rating (`lineup_row::RATING`) and one match into the double sums of `this` (`player_stats_fields::FLAGGED_RATING_SUM`/`player_stats_fields::FLAGGED_RATED_COUNT` with the match's flag `match_stats_record::NO_STATISTICS`, otherwise `player_stats_fields::RATING_SUM`/`player_stats_fields::RATED_COUNT`); into the 0x20-byte category records (`get_category_record`, or created by `exe::playerstats_create_stats`): matches, appearances, goals/assists and the rest of the row (`lineup_row::GOALS`..`lineup_row::RED_CARD`), goals for (the side's `match_stats_record::HOME_GOALS`) and against (`match_stats_record::AWAY_GOALS` − side), win and defeat, man of the match (`match_stats_record::MAN_OF_THE_MATCH_ID`), the words (`lineup_row::RATING`, `lineup_row::PASSES`, `lineup_row::PASSES_COMPLETED`, `lineup_row::TACKLES_WON`, `lineup_row::DRIBBLES`, `lineup_row::SHOTS`, `lineup_row::SHOTS_ON_TARGET`) and the minutes (`lineup_row::MINUTE_LEFT_PITCH`, `lineup_row::MINUTE_OFF` or the match duration `match_stats_record::DURATION`; a substitute subtracts the entry time `lineup_row::ENTRY_MINUTE`). In category 2 or with the competition counting (`exe::comp_util_is_league_division`): +1 match and the goals in the player's record (`player_stats_fields::PLAYER_ENTRIES`, 0x27 bytes: `player_stats_entry::CLUB_LEAGUE_GAMES`, `player_stats_entry::CLUB_LEAGUE_GOALS`) and, without a loan (`exe::contract_manager_get_loan_contract`), +1 on the contract's `contract::CLUB_APPEARANCES` (`contract_of_staff`). Finally the form (`player_stats_entry::RECENT_RATINGS`..`player_stats_entry::LAST_RATING`) shifts by half a byte and receives the rating. Returns 1.

For the nation's clubs (up to the first national team), archives (`exe::playerstats_archive_player_stats`) the statistics of every squad player not on loan elsewhere; 1 (0 and the "Error" box without a nation). \n `PlayerStats::end_season_for_key_nation(nation)`: without a nation, the "Error" box at line 0x396 and 0. Walks the clubs of `G_CLUB_COUNT` up to the first national team (`injury_is_national_team`: it stops there); a club of the nation (`exe::key_nation_index_of_club`, 72-byte record at 0xb63d60): each player (`.player()`, id below `G_STAFF_COUNT`) of the 50 slots (`.squad()`) without a loan (`exe::contract_manager_get_loan_contract` on `G_CONTRACT_MANAGER`) or on loan to the club itself (`.club_job()`) has his statistics archived (`exe::playerstats_archive_player_stats` with −1, 0, 0, −1, 0). Returns 1.

Removes a language from the player's language table (binary search) and shifts the later entries down. \n Removes language `language` of player `sheet` from the language table (`[stats + player_stats_fields::LANGUAGES]`, `[stats + player_stats_fields::LANGUAGE_COUNT]` entries of 6 bytes: id, language, fluency), found by binary search (`exe::crt_bsearch` with `player_stats_compare_language_entries`): the following entries move down one place, the last one becomes id −1 and language 0, and the count drops. Without a table or without the entry: nothing.

Returns the player's league appearances (field 1) or league goals (field 2) at the club, as a float. \n The player's league statistic at the club, as a float (fild): field 1 the matches (word +0x20) and field 2 the goals (word +0x22) of the 39-byte record at `[stats + player_stats_fields::PLAYER_ENTRIES]` + id × 39. Null player or any other field: the original (error box).

Returns the player's last match rating (6.5 with none). \n The last match rating of player `*id` (the low 4 bits of byte `player_stats_entry::LAST_RATING` of the 39-byte record at `[stats + player_stats_fields::PLAYER_ENTRIES]`, the statistics); with no rating, 6.5 (`rdata::F32_6_5`). Null player: the original (error box). Returns in st0.

Sums the goals of the player's seasons for the club in the career table (`build_career_history`), in 16 bits. \n The original receives the PlayerStats in ecx and does not read it. `player_stats_get_goals_for_club(person, club)` (called from MATCH_PLAYER::setup `exe::match_player_setup`, which writes it into +0x3d of the match player): null person, the "Error" box (line 0xb04) and 0; null club, the one at line 0xb0c and 0; id from `G_STAFF_COUNT` on, 0; without the player record (`.player()`), the one at line 0xb1e and 0. Otherwise the career table (`exe::playerstats_build_career_history` of `G_PLAYER_STATS`: 0x2b-byte entries, six per season and club) and the sum, in 16 bits, of byte +0xdf of the groups whose club (+0xd9, signed, non-negative) is the id of `club`; the table is freed (`exe::crt_free`, also when null). Hot (every player of every match): no counter.

Returns the competition weight by the club's two competitions (500/1000/300/100). \n The weight of competition `code` for player `p` by the club's two competitions (`.nation()` and `.second_nation()`): in the four special competitions (`KEY_NATION_SWEDEN` with 0x16/0x20, `KEY_NATION_NORWAY` with 0x1e/0x20, `KEY_NATION_DENMARK` with 0x16/0x1e, `KEY_NATION_BELGIUM` with 7) and in the competition's codes `.second_language()`/`.third_language()`: 500/1000/500/300 by the first, 300/500/300/100 by the second; no competition, 0. Returns only `ax`.

`Staff_Records::add_league_champions_record(club, comp)`: records the league champion. SEH frame only for the local dates. Called by the league champions at the end of each league (25 callers, one per league; 4 calls up to 2002-06-01). 
 Null club or competition: the error box (line 0x21c); the competition without an object in `G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE` (+ 4 × id): the error box (0x224). The reputation (up to weight × 500, +750 at most); with `.division()` and the club's `.stadium()` block: `.max_attendance()` goes up weight × 20 (below 150000 and below `.attendance()` + 500) and the block's `.expansion_capacity()` by 25 × (weight + 20) (below 120000). The players' threshold: ftol((`.club_count()` − 1) × the object's `.legs()` × 0.33), in 16 bits. 
 With a manager (`.manager()`): his three ratings (`non_player::CURRENT_REPUTATION` weight × 400, `non_player::HOME_REPUTATION` weight × k1, `non_player::WORLD_REPUTATION` weight × k2 in the `.non_player()` record, if any) and the history (type 5: the club and the competition); his record (`exe::staff_records_get_manager_record` with create): +1 in `.leagues_won()` and weight × 5000 in `.year_points()`, `.month_points()` and `.season_points()`. The chairman (`.chairman()`). 
 The 50 in the squad (`.squad()`) with a player sheet, valid, of the club (`.club_job()`) and other than the manager: the average 2/1 (`exe::playerstats_get_stat` with 6.5) above the threshold gives the history, morale +20 (`exe::staff_adjust_morale`) and +100 on the contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`) with the renewal; otherwise morale +10 and +50 on the contract. The club's history (type 5); with the media (`G_MEDIA`) and weight above 3, the praise (`queue_trophy_praise_story` with 1) and, above 12, with 3.

`Staff_Records::add_cup_winners_record(club, game, fixture)` (the club, the fixture and the match record): records the cup winner. SEH frame only for the local dates. Called by the cup finals (29 callers; 11 calls up to 2002-06-01). \n Nulls: the error box (line 0x51e). The reputation (as in the league); with a manager (`.manager()`) who has a non-player record (`.non_player()`): the three ratings of the club's side in the match (`match_record::HOME_MANAGER_CURRENT_REPUTATION` and the next two words, side `match_record::SIDE_SIZE` × away; weight × 400, × k1, × k2); the manager's history (type 0: the club and the competition of the fixture's `.competition()`); his record (`exe::staff_records_get_manager_record` with create): +1 in `.cups_won()` and ftol(weight^4 × 0.5) (CRT pow 0x945ff0, `game_pow`) in `.year_points()`, `.month_points()` and, for a national team (`is_national_team`), `.national_season_points()`, otherwise `.season_points()`. The chairman (`.chairman()`) and the 20 of the line-up (`match_record::ROW_STAFF_ID`). \n The 50 in the squad while the reputation does not exceed weight × 400: with a player sheet, valid and other than the manager, morale +15 (`exe::staff_adjust_morale`) and +100 on the contract; with contract status (`.squad_status()` >> 4) 1-3 or 5, the renewal. The call-ups of the stored competition (`exe::national_teams_is_finals_comp`) end (`exe::nationalteams_end_duty_for_competition`); the club's history (type 0); with the media and weight above 10, the praise (`queue_trophy_praise_story` with 1) and, with weight above 12 or reputation below 2500, with 3.

`Staff_Records::clear_human_manager_record(person)`: clears a human manager's record. Called by the human manager's retirement (0x6b2b40) and by setup (0x82b9xx). \n A person among the 16 humans (id from `G_STAFF_COUNT` − 16 to `G_STAFF_COUNT`): his record in vector `staff_records_fields::MANAGER_RECORDS` (slot id − `G_STAFF_COUNT` + `G_NON_PLAYER_COUNT` + 16, 0xd2 bytes); otherwise, as in the original, the person itself. Zeroes the 0xd2 bytes and puts −1 in +0x86, +0xc2, +0xc6, +0x4a, +0x5e and +0x72.

`Staff_Records::record_match_result(p, m)` (the fixture and the match): records a match in both managers' records. Called by the closing of the day's match (`close_day_match`), for each game. \n Match not played (`.category()` = `match_category::FRIENDLY`): nothing. The records of the two managers (+0xcf of the home side `.home_club()` and of the away side `.away_club()`; `get_manager_record` with create, through `club_manager_record`): +1 game (`manager_record::GAMES`); goals for (`.goals_for()`) and against (`.goals_against()`) from the score (`.home_goals_extra_time()`/`.away_goals_extra_time()`, or `.home_goals()`/`.away_goals()` with `.home_goals_extra_time()` = −1); win (`manager_record::WINS`, bonus 900), draw (`manager_record::DRAWS`, 300 for both) or loss (`manager_record::LOSSES`). Each one's rating (`get_fixture_match_importance` with 0 / 1, the opponent's reputation, the match points at +0x11f.. / +0x744..; importance × opponent reputation × weight × points) goes to `.year_points()` and `.month_points()` (month and year); in the club's league (`.division()` or `.reserve_division()` = the competition `.competition()`) also to the month's points (`manager_record::MONTH_LEAGUE_POINTS`); for a national team (`is_national_team`) to `.national_season_points()`, otherwise `.season_points()` (season). \n Defect of the original, reproduced: for the away manager, `.national_season_points()`/`.season_points()` receive the routine's [esp+0x10], which is the home manager's rating (or his bonus, without a record).

`Staff_Records::add_league_finish_records(league)`: at the end of the league, each club's final position in its manager's history. SEH frame only for the local date. Called by the completed league (`league_check_complete`). \n For each row of the table (`exe::league_get_table_row`, up to `.club_count()`), the history of the club's manager (`.manager()`; type 0xa: the club id, the competition of `.competition()`, the year `.stage_id()` and the position k + 1), in the archive (0x58e340).

`Staff_Records::add_supporters_player_of_year_record(person, club, a, b)`: the supporters' player of the year. SEH frame only for the local date. Called by the end of season of the records (0x447880). \n The person's history (type 0x35: the club id, `a` as unsigned 16 bits and `b`), in the archive (0x58e340); then, if draw(21 − the person's `.loyalty()`) < draw(10), the person likes the club (`exe::staff_add_favoured_club` with draw(2)) and the club likes him (`exe::club_add_favoured_staff` with draw(2)). Null person: the original (the error box and the read of the null person's `.loyalty()`).

`Staff_Records::record_manager_job_change(manager, club, signed)`: closes the manager's current spell, opens the new one when hired and counts the spells. SEH frame only for the local dates. Called by the manager's departure (`remove_club_manager`) and by the new manager (`reset_board_for_new_manager`). \n Outside a national team (`is_national_team`), in the manager's record (`exe::staff_records_get_manager_record` with create), when the game start (`G_GAME_START_DATE`) is not after today (`G_CURRENT_DATE`): the current spell (`manager_record::CURRENT_CLUB` club, `manager_record::CURRENT_CLUB_SINCE` start) closes; the shortest (`manager_record::SHORTEST_CLUB`, `manager_record::SHORTEST_START` start, `manager_record::SHORTEST_END` end) is replaced by the current one if there is none or if the current one is shorter (`exe::date_days_since`), or only has its end renewed if it is the same; the longest (`manager_record::LONGEST_CLUB`, `manager_record::LONGEST_START`, `manager_record::LONGEST_END`) is replaced if the current one is longer (the end becomes `manager_record::CURRENT_CLUB_END`) or if there is none (the end becomes today). Then `manager_record::CURRENT_CLUB` = −1 and, with signed = 1, the new spell (the club id, today, `manager_record::CURRENT_CLUB_END` = 13/11/1975 from `exe::date_date_549f70`) and +1 in `manager_record::CLUB_JOBS`. For a national team, signed = 1: +1 in `manager_record::NATIONAL_JOBS`. \n The histories: the manager's (type 0x96: club, signed), the club chairman's (`.chairman()`; type 0x97 with the manager and the three keys) and the club's (type 0x96 in +8, the manager, the keys and signed). Null manager or club: the error box (line 0x3b1).

`staff_records_compare_clubs_by_manager_points(a, b)`: the qsort order of the manager of the year candidates (`get_manager_of_year_candidates`): orders two clubs by their manager's league season points, highest first. \n The records of the two clubs' managers (club_manager_record_global); neither, 0; only `a`'s missing, 1; only `b`'s missing, −1; with both, `b`'s league season points (`.season_points()`) minus `a`'s (more points first).

`Staff_Records::add_promotion_record(club, comp, weight)`: records a promotion. SEH frame without a destructor. \n The club's reputation (`.reputation()`) goes up 500 (up to 10000) and `.max_attendance()` goes up 10 × the competition's importance (`.reputation()`) if it is below 150000 and below `.attendance()` + 500. The manager (`.manager()`) with a non-player record: ratings `non_player::CURRENT_REPUTATION`, +8 and `non_player::WORLD_REPUTATION` go up by the competition's importance (that of its club competition record `.upper_division_id()`, if any; `competition::REPUTATION`) × 400, × 200/400 (foreigner in the league with `.club_sides()` = 1, `exe::database_is_staff_foreign`) and × 200/400 (league with `.club_sides()` = 1) × 10/61, with a minimum of importance × weight. \n The manager's and chairman's (`.chairman()`) history (type 8), the manager's points (`exe::staff_records_get_manager_record`: `manager_record::YEAR_POINTS`, `manager_record::SEASON_POINTS`, `manager_record::MONTH_POINTS` add importance × weight × 25), morale +15 for each squad player (`staff_adjust_morale`), the contract bond (`.morale()`) +75 (−100..100) and the renewal (`contract_manager_offer_contract`) of the expiring contracts of types 1, 2, 3 and 5; finally the club's history (type 8). Null club or competition: the "Error" box (line 0x301).

`Staff_Records::add_relegation_record(club, comp)`: records a relegation. SEH frame without a destructor. \n The club's reputation (`.reputation()`) drops 500 (minimum 750). The manager with a non-player record: ratings `non_player::CURRENT_REPUTATION` (−16), +8 (−8 if a foreigner, `exe::database_is_staff_foreign`, or −16) and `non_player::WORLD_REPUTATION` (−8) × the competition's importance (`.reputation()`), clamped to 1..10000; the manager's and chairman's history (type 9). Each squad player: morale −15 (`staff_adjust_morale`) and, by contract type (`.squad_status()` >> 4): 1 and 2, reputations × 0.9 and the renewal (`contract_manager_offer_contract`) if expiring; 3 to 5, reputations × 0.95. Finally the club's history (type 9). Null club or competition: the "Error" box (line 0x476).

`Staff_Records::add_qualified_for_round_record(club, comp, stage, round, weight)`: SEH frame without a destructor. \n With a manager (`.manager()`), his history (type 3: club, competition or −1, the signed stage and the base round `exe::comp_util_get_base_round_id`) and the points (`exe::staff_records_get_manager_record`): importance² × weight added to `manager_record::YEAR_POINTS` (year), `manager_record::MONTH_POINTS` (month) and, for a national team (`exe::database_is_national_team`), `manager_record::NATIONAL_SEASON_POINTS` (cup), or for a club `manager_record::SEASON_POINTS` (league). Null club: the "Error" box (line 0x703).

`Staff_Records::add_transfer_records(transfer)`: updates the buying and selling managers' records and the transfer histories. SEH frame without a destructor. \n The person's contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`) goes to `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT` and gives the seller (outside state 5); the offer's total value (`exe::transfer_offer_get_total_value` with 1, 0, 0, 1). The buyer's manager (`club::MANAGER`), when the offer type is for a player (`.job_type()`, `exe::database_is_player_job`): in the record (`get_manager_record`) the biggest signing (+0..+0x24, from `manager_record::BIGGEST_PURCHASE_DATE` to `manager_record::BIGGEST_PURCHASE_BUYER`, if the value exceeds `manager_record::BIGGEST_PURCHASE_FEE`), the signings (`manager_record::PLAYERS_BOUGHT`), the spending (`manager_record::PURCHASES_TOTAL`, 64 bits), the players given in exchange (`manager_record::PLAYERS_SOLD`) and their value (`staff::VALUE` of each, in `manager_record::SALES_TOTAL`). The seller's manager, when the person's job is player (`staff::JOB_FOR_CLUB`): the biggest sale (`manager_record::BIGGEST_SALE_PERSON`..+0x49 if it exceeds `manager_record::BIGGEST_SALE_FEE`), the sales (`manager_record::PLAYERS_SOLD`), the income (`manager_record::SALES_TOTAL`), the players received (`manager_record::PLAYERS_BOUGHT`) and their value (`manager_record::PURCHASES_TOTAL`). \n The histories (types 0x64 buy, 0x65 sale, 0x66 transfer) of the buyer's manager, the seller's manager, the person and the exchange players, in the archive (0x58e340).

`Staff_Records::add_knocked_out_record(club, comp, stage, round, _)`: SEH frame without a destructor. \n The manager's history (`.manager()`; type 4: club, competition or −1, the signed stage and the base round `exe::comp_util_get_base_round_id`) and the end of the national team's call-ups in the stored competition. Null club: the "Error" box (line 0x73b).

`Staff_Records::daily_update(date)`: if the date's month (`exe::date_get_month`) or year (+2) are not the stored ones (`staff_records_fields::CURRENT_MONTH` month, `staff_records_fields::CURRENT_YEAR` year), zeroes the month's points (`manager_record::MONTH_POINTS`, `manager_record::MONTH_LEAGUE_POINTS`) of every record (`staff_records_fields::MANAGER_RECORDS`) and stores the new month and year. \n On the first day of the year (day +0 = 0) passes the year's points (`manager_record::YEAR_POINTS`) of each record with a person (`manager_record::OWNER`) to the hall of fame (`exe::halloffame_add_calendar_year_entry` on `G_HALL_OF_FAME`) and zeroes them.

`Staff_Records::end_season_for_nation(entry)`: at the end of the competition's season passes its managers' league and cup points to the hall of fame and clears them. \n With the entry's competition (+0, id at its +0; no competition −1; no competition and +4 not equal to `KEY_CONTINENT_EUROPE`, nothing), for each record (`staff_records_fields::MANAGER_RECORDS`): league (+0xc2) of the competition: adds the cup (+0xbe) if it also belongs to that competition (+0xc6 = −1, +0xbe = 0), passes the points (`manager_record::SEASON_POINTS`) to the hall of fame (`exe::halloffame_add_league_entry` on `G_HALL_OF_FAME`) if the competition keeps them (`.league_selected()`), zeroes them and +0xc2 = −1; only the competition's cup: passes +0xbe, zeroes it and +0xc6 = −1.

`Staff_Records::find_manager_of_the_month(index)`: the league manager with the most points this month. \n In the league (`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE` by the index; `.comp_type()` must be `comp_type::LEAGUE`, otherwise the "Error" box and 0), among the clubs of the table (`.table()`, `league_table_row::SIZE` bytes, count `.club_count()`) with a manager (`.manager()`) at the club (`.club_job()`) since two weeks ago (`exe::date_sub_weeks` of the game date; year `.date_joined_club_year()` unsigned, day `.date_joined_club()` signed), the one with the most points in the month (`.month_league_points()` of the record `exe::staff_records_get_manager_record`, created if missing), only above 0. Returns the manager or 0.

`Staff_Records::get_manager_of_year_candidates(clubs, n)` (called by 0x768940; SEH frame without an object with a destructor): sorts the clubs and keeps up to three. \n The qsort of the `n` clubs (`staff_records_compare_clubs_by_manager_points`) and, in order, up to three whose manager (`club::MANAGER`) arrived (`.date_joined_club()`) before today − 28 weeks (`FN_DATE_SUB_WEEKS`; year unsigned, day signed) and has a record (`exe::staff_records_get_manager_record` with 1) with games (`.games()`), copied to the start of the vector itself. Returns how many.

`Staff_Records::get_manager_record(person, create)`: finds (or creates, or takes over) the manager's 210-byte record (vector `staff_records_fields::MANAGER_RECORDS`). \n Null person: the error box at line 0xf6e and 0. Free slot (`manager_record::OWNER` = −1): without `create`, 0; with it, the slot takes the id. Someone else's slot: zeroes the record of that person (−1 in +0x86, +0xc2, +0xc6, +0x4a, +0x5e, +0x72) and looks again. \n Updates the nations of the club (`.club_job()`) and of the national team (`.national_job()`) in `manager_record::SEASON_NATION`/`manager_record::NATIONAL_NATION`, zeroing the points (`manager_record::SEASON_POINTS`/`manager_record::NATIONAL_SEASON_POINTS`) when they change. With the date of `G_GAME_START_DATE` up to today: no spell (`manager_record::CURRENT_CLUB` = −1), opens the current club's one (since the person's `staff::DATE_JOINED_CLUB`; `manager_record::CURRENT_CLUB_END` = the date 13/11/1975 from `exe::date_date_549f70`); the longest (`manager_record::LONGEST_CLUB`, `manager_record::LONGEST_START`..`manager_record::LONGEST_END`) and the shortest (`manager_record::SHORTEST_CLUB`, `manager_record::SHORTEST_START`..`manager_record::SHORTEST_END`) through `exe::date_days_since`, today's in `manager_record::LONGEST_END` / `manager_record::SHORTEST_END`. Returns the record.

`Staff_Records::add_free_release_records(person)`: the free release histories. SEH frame only for the local date, with an empty destructor. \n The person's contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`) goes to `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT` and gives the club (`club::SIZE`-byte record of `G_CLUB_TABLE` through `.club()`). With a manager at the club (`.manager()`), his history (type 0x68: the club, the person and her three ids +0x33 of +4, +8 and +0xc); then the person's (type 0x67: the club or −1), in the archive (0x58e340). Null person: the "Error" box (line 0x1010).

`Staff_Records::add_loan_records(person, of, club)` (called by `handle_player_accepted_terms`, the accepted transfer): the loan histories. SEH frame only for the local date, with an empty destructor. \n With the club and its manager (`.manager()`), the manager's history (type 0x69: the club, the person and her three ids +0x33 of +4, +8 and +0xc, and the id of `of`); then, in the same entry, the person's (type 0x6a: the club and the id of `of`), in the archive (0x58e340). The club is read before the person check, as in the original; null person: the "Error" box (line 0x1010).

`Staff_Records::rewind_staff_history(person)`: the person's history list (the 8-byte pair at [`staff_records_fields::PERSON_HISTORY_LISTS`] + 8 × id) drops the last entry (`exe::file_llist_reset_last_offset` on [this]: the second offset, +4 of the pair, = −1). \n Null person: the original (fatal box: the game ends).

`Staff_Records::add_year_award_record(p, club, prize, a4, a5, credito)`: records a year award. SEH frame without a destructor. Called by the recording of the year award winners (YEAR_AWARD::record_winners 0x9302f0: the first, the second and the third). \n Entry 0x34 of the person's history (game date, club or −1, the award id, a4 in the word, a5 and the credit as signed bytes; 0x58e340). Manager (`.job_for_club()` or `.job_for_nation()` = 5 or 0xc): +1 in the word `manager_record::AWARDS` of his record (`get_manager_record`). \n A player with a player sheet (`.player()`) and a contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, other than type 5) with the club (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`): with the transfer manager, a contract of more than 300 days and the player on the club's list (`exe::shortlist_manager_find_club_shortlist_entry`), the renewal (`contract_manager_offer_contract`); then, only with credit 1, without the contract's `.grievances()` flag, with `.loyalty()` above 15 and `.professionalism()` above 10, if draw(`.loyalty()`) is above 5 (a draw by loyalty): the news of thanks to the manager (`exe::news_post_player_credits_manager_for_award`). No person or no award: the original ("Error" box).

`Staff_Records::add_first_cap_record(person, opponent)` (called by the international result `record_international_result`): the first cap history. SEH frame only for the local date, with an empty destructor. \n The person's history (type 6: the contracting club `.club_job()` or −1, the opponent's id in the match and the age `.age()`, signed), in the archive (0x58e340). The club is read before the person check, as in the original; null person: the "Error" box (line 0x1010).

`Staff_Records::add_month_award_record(p, club, prize, a4, a5)`: writes the winner's 0x33 history entry. SEH frame without a destructor. \n Entry 0x33 of the person's history (game date, club or −1, the award id, a4 in the byte, a5 in the word; 0x58e340). Manager (`.job_for_club()` or `.job_for_nation()` = 5 or 0xc): +1 in the word `manager_record::AWARDS` of his record (`get_manager_record`). \n A player with a player sheet (`.player()`) and a contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, other than type 5) with the club (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`): with the transfer manager, a contract of more than 300 days and the player on the club's list (`exe::shortlist_manager_find_club_shortlist_entry`), the renewal (`contract_manager_offer_contract`); then, without the contract's `.grievances()` flag, with `.loyalty()` above 15 and `.professionalism()` above 10, if draw(`.loyalty()`) is above 5: the news of thanks to the manager (`exe::news_post_player_credits_manager_for_award`). No person or no award: the original ("Error" box).
